answers.title: Courses 2027 | Hollin Craft School
answers.text:
# Hollin Craft School: courses for 2027

Every course runs in the Mill Street studios. Book through the front desk.

## Pottery for beginners

Six sessions of three hours, at most 7 students. Materials are included and aprons are provided. The studio is on the ground floor with step-free access, and tools are shared at each bench. Sessions start on the hour; latecomers join at the first break so the demonstration is not interrupted. Work made in the course is fired, bound or finished by the studio team and can be collected two weeks after the last session. Students who miss a session may join the same session of the next run of the course, when there is room.
